background_story: Atreus was a young scholar who had always been fascinated by the mystical traditions of the East. Growing up in a family of modest means, he spent most of his free time studying the ancient texts and philosophies of the Ismaili Muslims. As he delved deeper into the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad and the Imam Ali, Atreus became increasingly drawn to the esoteric interpretations of the Quran. He spent years studying under the guidance of a wise Ismaili mentor, learning the intricacies of gnosis and the secrets of the universe. Atreus's devotion to the faith only deepened as he traveled to the mountains of Central Asia, where he encountered the remnants of the ancient Nizari Ismaili communities. His experiences there transformed him, and he returned home with a newfound sense of purpose, determined to share the wisdom of Ismailism with a world in need of its timeless truths.
